scope: Full registered Node/browser regression plus actual isolated Blender base/refined rendering and continuous sync

fixes.issue: Corrupt cabinet configuration aborted the input upgrade and blocked the existing startup recovery UI
fixes.fix: Retain the complete broken record, upgrade healthy siblings, and preserve strict import validation

fixes.issue: Nonuniform scale with rotation/mirror introduced about 1 mm Blender geometry error through TRS decomposition
fixes.fix: Normalize exported TRS rotation and bake residual shear only into private snapshot geometry; expand sheared instances

fixes.issue: Invisible 3D layer could intercept 2D clicks during its delayed visibility transition
fixes.fix: Disable 3D hit testing in 2D and enable it only while 3D is active

fixes.issue: Reopening a refined render panel reset the explicit ceiling choice
fixes.fix: Apply default ceilings only until the user makes a choice

fixes.issue: Legacy fixtures expected absent cabinet fields or implicitly created combined kitchen groups on refresh
fixes.fix: Use canonical independent structures and current upgrade expectations without changing distance thresholds

fixes.issue: Folding-table clicks used stale camera/geometry coordinates before the real camera transition completed
fixes.fix: Wait for the production stable-camera signature and project the current model using its real camera

fixes.issue: Real Blender sync acceptance exceeded its three-minute wait during full regression
fixes.fix: Allow ten minutes for the isolated receiver and compare every sofa component rather than a random first component

notRun: Other operating systems, Blender versions and physical GPUs other than local OptiX
Physical touch devices and manufacturer installation/construction verification
Re-rendering the historical four-region 1601 final images or reinstalling third-party MCP in this run
knownLimits: Furniture without production solid data retains conservative envelopes; curved/rounded approximations remain documented
Blender synchronization remains one-way complete snapshots and is not interactive real-time path tracing
Refinement uses the registered saved .blend; unsaved interactive edits are not automatically captured
Arbitrary external linked assets/modifiers are not covered; historical render/sync files are not auto-cleaned
environment: Windows; Chrome; installed Store Blender; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER / OptiX
notes: Initial sandbox EACCES/EPERM were rechecked with normal local permissions; they are not classified as product defects
No local project bytes changed; data already exists on origin/main and no empty data commit is needed
The sync receiver PNG is a diagnostic render for pipeline verification, not an interior composition/quality acceptance image.
